title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the Global X Bitcoin Trust Under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), Commodity-Based Trust Shares
summary: On 23 August 2021, the Federal Register published an SEC notice that Cboe BZX Exchange had filed a proposed rule change (File No. SR-CboeBZX-2021-052, filed 3 August 2021) to list and trade shares of the Global X Bitcoin Trust under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), the exchange's Commodity-Based Trust Shares listing standard. The trust's sponsor is Global X Digital Assets, LLC; the filing states that the trust's assets will consist of bitcoin held by the custodian on the trust's behalf, and that the trust generally does not intend to hold cash except on a temporary basis in limited situations. Publication of the notice opened a public comment period under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1), the first procedural step before the Commission could approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on the proposed listing; the notice itself takes no position on, and does not resolve, how the SEC will ultimately act on the proposal.
why_it_matters: This is the procedural first step the SEC required before it could approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on a proposed crypto exchange-traded product listing: publishing the exchange's proposal and inviting public comment. It does not itself approve or disapprove anything, and this notice does not address the proposal's eventual outcome.

citations.quote: The Commission is publishing this notice to solicit comments on the proposed rule change
